result.reason: The operative language includes all preferred coverages and limits, the conditional USD 5 million cyber/privacy coverage, legally required workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. It preserves the existing provisions by adding a separate subsection. However, requiring the insurance to continue for one year after expiration is not in the playbook and adds an unnecessary substantive obligation, particularly for CGL. Drafting is otherwise professional, though using a defined term such as “Customer Data,” if available, would be more precise than “Sparkling’s data.”
